name: ASA GitHub Evidence Audit
purpose: Create traceable evidence for repository activity without reading secrets, overstating current state, or modifying external repositories.

repository_visibility_policy.rule: Every committed byte must be safe for public access. Protected or non-public material must remain outside this repository in a separately approved private environment.
repository_visibility_policy.license_boundary: Public visibility does not grant open-source rights or change copyright ownership.

evidence.verification_rule: Internal Test Only requires a successful GitHub Actions evidence-audit run tied to the relevant commit.

freshness_rule.rule: Historical records are preserved as evidence of what was true when recorded and must not be silently promoted to current state without a new live verification.

chatgpt_integration.mode: connected GitHub audit and evidence summarization
chatgpt_integration.write_policy: GitHub mutation requires an explicit current user instruction and must be confirmed by resulting GitHub state. Tool availability is runtime context and must not be stored as a permanent capability claim.
chatgpt_integration.secret_policy: never request, display, or store PAT/API secrets in repository files
